evidence_label: HIST (historical simulation on Alpaca SIP minute bars); SYN for the unit tests. Nothing here is paper or live behaviour.
question: Does the Zarattini-Barbon-Aziz Stocks-in-Play 5-minute opening-range breakout (top 20 by opening relative volume) earn a positive mean net R after measured spreads and regulatory fees on sessions after its publication (2024-01-02..2026-08-14), and does it reproduce on the paper's sample years that we hold?
prior_expectation: fail. A primary-source review rated the claim weak: the paper models a per-share commission only and fills stops at the trigger; an independent QuantConnect port with IBKR fees and slippage reported Sharpe 0.17 (2016-19) and -0.47 (2020-23). Our v1 (0/768) and v2 (0/244) mover studies failed after costs. The study runs because the strategy trades liquid names where measured costs may be far smaller than on $1-50 movers.

source.citation: Zarattini, C., Barbon, A., Aziz, A. (2024). A Profitable Day Trading Strategy For The U.S. Equity Market. SSRN 4729284, first version 16 Feb 2024.
source.pages_read: printed pp.5-19 (PDF pages 5-19): Section 2 Strategy Definition, 2.1 Base Strategy, Position Sizing, Table 1, Section 3 and Fig. 4, Section 4 and Table 2, Section 5 and Table 3

rules_quoted.universe: p.9: 'The opening price had to be above $5. The average trading volume over the previous 14 days had to be at least 1,000,000 shares per day. The ATR over the previous 14 days had to be more than $0.50.' p.7: all equities listed on NYSE and Nasdaq, CRSP, survivorship-free; intraday data from IQFeed, unadjusted.
rules_quoted.relative_volume: p.14: RelativeVolume_{t,j} = ORVolume_{t,j} / ((1/14) sum_{i=1..14} ORVolume_{t-i,j}), ORVolume = volume in the first 5 minutes. p.15: 'Relative Volume had to be at least 100%' and 'Trade the stocks with the top 20 Relative Volume.'
rules_quoted.entry: p.9: stop order at the 5-minute high after a bullish first 5 minutes (09:30-09:35 ET), at the 5-minute low after a bearish one; 'In the case of a doji (open = close) forming in the first 5 minutes, no order was placed.' p.6: long-only after a bullish candle, short-only after a bearish one.
rules_quoted.stop_and_exit: p.9: 'we placed a stop loss order at a 10% ATR distance from the executed entry price. If the stop loss was not reached intraday, we closed the position at the end of the trading session (i.e., 4:00 pm ET).'
rules_quoted.sizing: p.10 and p.16: each position traded so that a stop-out loses 1% of 'the capital deployed for that position'; maximum leverage 4x; footnote 3: the leverage cap may make the loss less than 1%.
rules_quoted.sample_and_costs: p.10: 1 Jan 2016 - 31 Dec 2023, $25,000 start, $0.0035 per share commission (IBKR Pro Tiered entry level).
rules_quoted.r_unit: p.7: R = the potential maximum loss per share (the stop distance, 10% of ATR).

minute_corpus.lane: full (universe A union, 926 symbols); the 230 universe-B-only symbols (16:00-19:59 only) are excluded
minute_corpus.identity: bars requested by the ticker current on 2026-09-22 (provider asof); renames and reused tickers carry the daily dataset's measured limits

daily_bars.use: ATR14 and 14-day average volume from sessions strictly before t; from session t only the share-adjustment ratio all_v/raw_v (a corporate-action schedule, public before the open) to detect a split between t-1 and t (D8); point-in-time liquidity membership (med20 from sessions before t)

session_calendar.use: session order for the 14-session windows; 13:00 close on scheduled early closes

data.quotes: Alpaca /v2/stocks/quotes, feed=sip, asof=2026-09-22, GET only, for the preregistered cost sample (cost_table)
data.corporate_actions: Alpaca GET /v1/corporate-actions (types forward_split, reverse_split, 2016-12-01..2026-08-14) for the 926 corpus symbols, used only to cross-check D8 (split_check.py)

universe.pool: D1 (review fix 1): point-in-time top-500 liquidity membership. On each session t every daily.parquet symbol is ranked by med20 = median raw dollar volume over the 20 sessions t-20..t-1 (strictly before t), among symbols with 20 and 60 calendar-contiguous prior sessions with bars, raw close of t-1 >= $5, med20 >= $20M and no warrant/unit/right suffix (the stage-1 construction, applied per session instead of per year). The 500 highest med20 (ties by symbol; the same N as universe A) are members on t; members outside the 926-symbol minute corpus are dropped (coverage limitation, counted in membership.counts.json). orb_prepare.py membership.
universe.filters_1_3: open > $5 (the first 09:30-09:34 minute bar's open), 14-day average share volume >= 1,000,000, 14-day ATR > $0.50; all from sessions strictly before t
universe.superseded_pool: universe A per-year membership (each calendar year ranked by the median of med20 over the whole year: same-year future data). Replaced before any outcome; its selection is kept privately under v1-membership/ for the change count only.

membership_counts.missing_share: 3.2% of member symbol-days in both segments; per year 2.1%-4.7% (membership.counts.json)

change_vs_superseded_pool.post_publication_orders: 13,079 now vs 13,077 before; 1,596 orders only under the new pool, 1,594 only under the old (625 of 657 sessions changed)
change_vs_superseded_pool.reproduction_orders: 34,633 now vs 34,639 before; 3,907 only new, 3,913 only old

features.opening_range: bars 09:30..09:34 (et_minute 570-574): open = first bar's open, high = max high, low = min low, close = last bar's close, volume = sum; a symbol-day with no bar in that window is not a candidate
features.direction: +1 if OR close > OR open, -1 if below, 0 (doji, no order) if equal
features.relvol: OR volume on t / mean OR volume over the 14 calendar sessions t-14..t-1, all in t's share units (volume factor all_v/raw_v, plus a split ratio between t-1 and t = (all_v/raw_v on t-1) / (all_v/raw_v on t) when it differs from 1 by more than 1%); a prior session with regular-hours bars but none in 09:30-09:34 counts as OR volume 0; a prior session with no bar at all voids the window
features.atr14: simple mean of the 14 true ranges of sessions t-14..t-1 (TR uses the previous close), computed on the adjusted daily series and rescaled to t-1's raw price basis by raw_c/all_c on t-1, then divided by the split ratio between t-1 and t
features.avg_volume14: mean adjusted volume over t-14..t-1 rescaled by raw_v/all_v on t-1 and the split ratio
features.windows_complete: all 15 (ATR) / 14 (volume, RelVol) prior calendar sessions must have a daily bar; otherwise the symbol-day is ineligible

selection: per session: filters 1-3, RelVol >= 1, then the 20 highest RelVol (ties by symbol ascending). Dojis keep their slot and place no order (C1). Sessions with fewer than 20 selectable names trade what they have; their count is reported.

orders.live: from the 09:35 bar through the last bar before the close (16:00, 13:00 on early closes)
orders.trigger: long: first bar with high >= OR high; short: first bar with low <= OR low; a touch triggers; a trigger counts from the start of its bar (D13)
orders.stop: 10% of ATR14 from the executed entry price (after spread/slippage under F1/F2)
orders.exit: stop, else the close of the last regular-session minute bar before the close (D10)
orders.same_bar: if the entry bar also reaches the stop, the trade is stopped in that bar at the stop (against the trade; F0, F1 and F2); the same-bar count is reported and F0fav resolves those bars in the trade's favour (descriptive, D6)

F0.costs: $0.0035/share each side, no minimum, no spread, no regulatory fees

F1.role: primary. F1 is not claimed to be conservative: its half-spreads are cell means measured at fixed stamps, not at the fills. The post-freeze quote check (quote_check) measures them at a sample of actual stop exits and gap-through fills.
F1.entry: the trigger, or the bar open when the bar opens beyond the trigger (gap-through), moved adversely by the measured half-spread of its cost cell
F1.stop_exit: the stop, or the bar open on a gap-through, minus (long) / plus (short) the half-spread
F1.eod: last bar close adjusted by the half-spread
F1.costs: zero commission; SEC Section 31 and FINRA TAF on every sale (a long's exit, a short's entry), fees-v3.json on the trade date

F2.definition: F1 plus 2 bps of the execution price adverse on every execution (orb_signal.F2_EXTRA = 0.0002), price-proportional instead of one tick

F0fav.definition: F0 with same-bar entry+stop bars resolved in the trade's favour (the stop test starts at the next bar)

cost_table.population: selected, non-doji orders that trigger (signal-firing timestamps), all sessions 2017-01-24..2026-08-14
cost_table.sample: sha256('symbol|session|dirn') first 8 bytes big-endian mod N == 0, N fixed per segment group before fetching (recorded in cost_table.sample_rate once the fired counts are known)
cost_table.stamps: four exit-agnostic times per sampled order: end of the trigger minute (trigger bar start + 60 s), trigger + 15 min, trigger + 60 min, close - 5 min; stamps at or after close - 5 min other than that one are dropped
cost_table.quote_rule: SIP quotes in [ts - 60 s, ts], newest first; the newest quote with bid > 0, ask > bid (not crossed, locked or zero); half-spread = (ask - bid) / (ask + bid)
cost_table.cells: time bucket x price tier x liquidity tier; time buckets ET [09:35,10:00), [10:00,11:00), [11:00,15:30), [15:30, close]; price tiers by the stamp's mid [5,20), [20,50), [50,200), [200, inf); liquidity tiers by 14-day average dollar volume (avg_volume14 x OR open) [0,100M), [100M,500M), [500M, inf)
cost_table.estimator: 5%-trimmed mean per cell with >= 30 observations; else the time x price fallback with >= 30; else the table's 90th percentile of its own measured/fallback values (the mover v1 method)
cost_table.groups: two tables: reproduction sessions (2017-2023) and post-publication sessions (2024-2026-08-14); each trade uses its own group's table
cost_table.lookup: an execution at minute m and price p of a symbol-day with liquidity tier k uses cell (bucket(m), tier(p), k); F0 uses none

sample_rate.fixed_at: 2026-09-25 after the first fired counts and before any quote request (collect_quotes.py SAMPLE_RATE); redrawn with the same key and rates after the D1 membership fix (28,920 and 10,771 fired; 2,926 and 2,136 sampled)

sizing.paper: D4: allocation per slot = start-of-day equity / 20; shares = min(0.01 x allocation / (0.1 x ATR14), 4 x allocation / entry fill); fractional shares; allocations of empty, doji and unfired slots stay in cash
sizing.compounding: daily, equity marked at each session's end
sizing.per_trade_R_fees: per-trade net R charges fees per share without the TAF per-trade cap (conservative; the cap only lowers fees); the portfolio charges them on its actual share counts, cap included

reproduction.role: descriptive reproduction of the paper's sample years we hold; reported for 2017-01-24..2021-12-31 and 2022-01-03..2023-12-29 separately and pooled. 2017-01-24 is the first session with 14 prior sessions of opening-range volume (the brief's 2017-01-03 start leaves 14 sessions with no selectable name, which would only add zero-return days to the portfolio)

post_publication.role: confirmatory; the items are tested here once, after the freeze

outcomes.per_trade: net R = (dirn x (exit fill - entry fill) x shares - explicit costs) / shares / (0.1 x ATR14), per fill model
outcomes.mean_R: mean over fired trades with a 95% percentile CI from a bootstrap clustered by session
outcomes.portfolio: daily returns and equity at 1x and at the paper sizing (D4), $25,000 start per segment/sub-period; CAGR, annualised volatility, Sharpe (sqrt 252, risk-free 0, all sessions including no-trade days), max drawdown, worst day, share of positive days, trade win rate
outcomes.break_even: per-side cost c* (fraction of price) at which mean net R = 0 given gross R and each trade's (entry + exit)/R_ps: c* = mean(gross R) / mean((P_in + P_out)/R_ps), reported in round-trip bps with a session-clustered bootstrap CI, beside the measured round-trip cost of the same trades (2 x mean half-spread + fees)
outcomes.legs: every statistic for combined, long-only and short-only trades

items.statistic: mean net R per fired trade
items.test: session-clustered bootstrap, centred; fixed sequence step at alpha 0.05
items.why: the direct post-publication test of the paper's per-trade edge after measured costs; primary

items.statistic: mean net R per fired long trade
items.test: session-clustered bootstrap, centred; fixed sequence step at alpha 0.05
items.why: historical borrow is unknown, so the short leg's feasibility is unmeasured; the long leg is computable without borrow and is what a cash account could trade

items.statistic: mean daily return over all post-publication sessions
items.test: bootstrap over sessions, centred; fixed sequence step at alpha 0.05
items.why: the paper's claim is a portfolio claim; sizing weights trades by 1/ATR up to the 4x cap, so the portfolio can differ in sign from the equal-weight per-trade mean

not_items.break_even_vs_measured_cost: reported with its CI but not tested: 'break-even cost >= measured cost' is the same event as 'mean net R at measured cost >= 0', i.e. ORB-1's point estimate, so a separate test would duplicate ORB-1 inside the family
not_items.reproduction: descriptive only (F0/F1/F2 on 2017-2021 and 2022-2023): Table 2 analogues, the Fig. 4 analogue (mean F0 net R by RelVol < 1, >= 1, >= 30 over all filter-1-3 names, base strategy) and the Table 1 analogue (all eligible names, allocation equity / eligible count); no gate

multiplicity.rule: test ORB-1 at 0.05; only if rejected test ORB-2 at 0.05; only if rejected test ORB-3 at 0.05; stop at the first non-rejection (later items are 'not tested'); controls the familywise error at 0.05

bootstrap.unit: session (all of a session's trades move together)

statistics.max_drawdown: max over t of 1 - equity_t / max_{s<=t} equity_s on the compounded daily equity
statistics.week_block_bootstrap: descriptive sensitivity: the ORB-1 statistic re-bootstrapped with ISO weeks as clusters (B and seed as above)

pre_outcome: verify-or: 0 mismatches between the SQL opening-range table and orb_signal.opening_range on the sha-keyed sample
every stamp of the cost sample complete (HTTP 200) or reported as incomplete; the table records its observation count
post-publication fired trades >= sample_size.n_min_trades, otherwise every item is reported as inconclusive (not as a fail)
split_check: every flagged D8 window compared with provider split records; disagreements disclosed in D8

verdict.supported: an item is 'supported on the 500 most liquid names' only if the fixed sequence rejects it, its F2 point estimate is > 0 (mean net R for ORB-1/ORB-2, Sharpe for ORB-3) and the quote-check-adjusted F1 mean net R is > 0
verdict.excluded: otherwise, for ORB-1/ORB-2: 'not supported; an effect >= 0.08R is excluded on the 500 most liquid names' only when the one-sided 95% upper bound of the F1 mean net R is < 0.08R
verdict.inconclusive: otherwise 'not supported, inconclusive at 0.08R on the 500 most liquid names' (ORB-3: 'not supported on the 500 most liquid names')
verdict.sample: if post-publication fired trades < n_min_trades every item reads 'inconclusive: post-publication trades below n_min'
verdict.otherwise: no parameter search, no re-run with other windows, no new segment

sample_size.method: normal approximation for a one-sided test at alpha 0.05 (each fixed-sequence step) with power 0.8; per-trade sd of net R assumed (no outcome is read) at 1.5, 2.0 and 3.0 R; a session design effect 1 + (m_bar - 1) x rho with rho in {0, 0.02, 0.05}. sd 2R with rho 0.02 is optimistic; sd 3R with rho 0.05 is reported beside it, and the verdict wording (gates.verdict) never reads a non-rejection as evidence of no effect unless the upper bound excludes 0.08R
sample_size.target_effect: +0.08 R (Fig. 4's RelVol > 1 average, net of commission)

table.reading: at the optimistic sd 2R / rho 0.02 both per-trade items can detect +0.08R (combined MDE 0.055R, long 0.072R); at sd 3R / rho 0.05 neither can (MDE 0.096R and 0.118R; n_min 15,387 and 11,847 against 10,771 and 5,421 trades). A non-rejection is therefore read as 'inconclusive at 0.08R' unless the upper bound excludes it (gates.verdict).

sample_size.n_min_basis: sd 2.0 R, rho 0.02, effect +0.08 R, one-sided alpha 0.05, power 0.8 (the sample gate)

deviations.what: Universe: the top 20 by RelVol are ranked within a point-in-time top-500 liquidity membership (ranked each session from sessions before t) intersected with the 926-symbol minute corpus, instead of all ~7,000 NYSE/Nasdaq stocks.
deviations.why: our minute corpus holds regular-hours bars for universe A only; the pool uses no same-year future data (review fix 1). Members outside the corpus (3.2% of member symbol-days) are dropped and counted; identities are current tickers. Verdicts are worded 'on the 500 most liquid names'.

deviations.what: Sample: 2017-01-24..2023-12-29 for reproduction (the paper covers 2016-2023) plus 2024-01-02..2026-08-14 post-publication.
deviations.why: the minute corpus starts 2017-01-03 and RelVol needs 14 prior sessions of opening-range volume; 2016 is not held.

deviations.what: Data: Alpaca SIP 1-minute bars aggregated to the 5-minute range; the open filter and the candle open use the first 09:30 minute bar's open rather than the official opening print; daily ATR and volume from Alpaca daily bars.
deviations.why: the paper used IQFeed intraday and CRSP data we do not hold.

deviations.what: Sizing: conservative reading. Each of 20 slots gets equity/20; a stop-out loses 1% of that allocation; notional is capped at 4x the allocation; fractional shares; unused slots stay in cash.
deviations.why: 'capital deployed for that position' is ambiguous. Reading it as 1% of total equity per position would risk ~20% of equity per day before the leverage cap binds; the per-slot reading keeps the book within 4x and the per-trade risk at 0.05% of equity. It cannot inflate returns relative to the other reading.

deviations.what: Costs: F1/F2 replace the paper's commission-only model with measured half-spreads, gap-through fills, zero commission and SEC/TAF on sells (F0 keeps the paper's). The SEC Section 31 rate is taken on the trade date although the rule keys it to settlement.
deviations.why: the claim under test is net profitability; the settlement-date offset only matters within two sessions of a rate change.

deviations.what: Same-bar ambiguity (entry and stop inside one minute bar) is resolved against the trade under every fill model, including F0. The count of same-bar trades is reported per segment and leg, with a descriptive F0 variant (F0fav) that resolves those bars in the trade's favour.
deviations.why: minute bars do not order the high and low; the paper does not state its intrabar rule.

deviations.what: ATR14 = simple mean of 14 true ranges from split/dividend-adjusted daily bars, rescaled to the decision session's raw basis.
deviations.why: the paper does not state Wilder smoothing or the price basis; an unadjusted range across a split would be spurious.

deviations.what: The 14-day ATR, volume and RelVol windows are split-consistent (converted to the decision session's share and price units). A split effective on t is detected from the share-adjustment ratio all_v/raw_v of t versus t-1; that ratio is the only field of session t's daily row that is used.
deviations.why: an unadjusted window across a split would move RelVol and ATR by the split ratio. The price-adjustment factor was rejected as a detector after it flagged ex-dividend and spin-off sessions (a pre-outcome feature check); the share factor changes only at splits and encodes a schedule announced before the open, not day-t trading.

cross_check.source: Alpaca /v1/corporate-actions forward and reverse splits, 19 GET requests, all HTTP 200, 278 split records for the 926 symbols (split_check.py; private split-check.json)
ratio_mismatch: TT 2020-03-02: detector 1.137, record 1.289 (Carrier/Otis spin-off with a share consolidation)
flagged_without_record: BALL 2017-05-17 (2.0; a real 2-for-1 split absent from the provider records)
DD 2019-04-02 (1.487; DowDuPont reverse split with the Dow spin-off)
SQQQ 2018-05-02 (1.019) and 2018-05-03 (0.988): an adjustment-factor artifact that nets out over two sessions
cross_check.disposition: kept as computed; the six disagreements are 6 of 1,163,382 member symbol-days and are disclosed here, not patched

deviations.what: Short leg: borrow is assumed available at zero fee; locates, hard-to-borrow fees and the Rule 201 short-sale restriction are not modelled.
deviations.why: historical borrow data are not held; ORB-2 (long only) does not depend on it. A descriptive short-leg sensitivity drops shorts on sessions where Rule 201 was plausibly active (prior session low <= 90% of its previous close).

deviations.what: The 16:00 exit uses the close of the last regular-session minute bar (15:59, or 12:59 on early closes) instead of the official closing auction.
deviations.why: the minute corpus has no separate auction price; F1 charges a half-spread on it.

deviations.what: Triggers and stops are evaluated on minute-bar highs and lows (a touch fills); no ticks, queue position, halts or LULD pauses.
deviations.why: no tick data are held; halted minutes have no bar and a gap-through fills at the next bar's open under F1/F2.

deviations.what: ETFs in universe A stay eligible.
deviations.why: the paper's Table 4 lists QQQ among 15-minute ORB names, so its universe appears to have included ETFs.

deviations.what: A trigger counts from the start of its minute bar (from the 09:35 bar's first second), so the first eligible moment is optimistic by up to a few seconds against an order placed after the 09:35 bar is known.
deviations.why: minute bars carry no sub-minute times; the 09:35 bar starts at 09:35:00, when the 5-minute candle has just closed.

clarifications.text: A doji ranked in the top 20 keeps its slot; the 21st name is not promoted.
RelVol ties break by symbol ascending.
An order that never triggers before the close is no trade and has no R; its slot's allocation stays in cash.
The stop is 10% of ATR from the F1/F2 executed fill (after the half-spread and, under F2, the 2 bps), per the paper's 'executed entry price'; R per share stays 0.1 x ATR14 for every fill model.
Average volume must be >= 1,000,000 ('at least'); open and ATR thresholds are strict ('above', 'more than').
Positions are flat at the close; nothing carries overnight; each session's P&L is realised that session.

limitations: Historical borrow, locates and hard-to-borrow fees are unknown (D9).

The pool is a point-in-time top-500 liquidity ranking intersected with the minute corpus: 3.2% of member symbol-days (265 symbols post-publication, 467 in reproduction) are outside the corpus and dropped; identities are current tickers (D1).
Minute bars cannot order events inside a minute (D6, D11); the quote-measured half-spread is sampled at fixed stamps, not at each fill.
The post-publication segment overlaps the stage-1 'interim' segment that other hypotheses on the same corpus may have read; this ORB rule set has not been evaluated on it.
Spreads were measured by sampling and apply by cell; queue position, partial fills, market impact beyond the F2 2 bps and data-vendor differences are not modelled.

allowed_before_freeze_on_real_data: opening-range features up to 09:35 and 14-day windows before t
the first trigger minute of each selected order (signal-firing timestamps, from bar highs/lows only)
SIP quote spreads at the trigger minute and the fixed exit-agnostic stamps
sample-size and MDE arithmetic from counts
provider split records for the D8 cross-check
freeze_discipline.forbidden_before_freeze: any fill price, stop, exit, return, P&L, R, hit rate or price change after a decision time, or anything derived from them, including sanity checks
freeze_discipline.guard: simulate.py run, quote_check.py and evaluate.py run refuse unless: evidence/freeze-record.json exists and records --protocol-sha256; protocol.json hashes to it and has status frozen_before_outcomes with frozen_before_outcomes true; the study directory's git tree is clean (HEAD is recorded); every pinned private artifact and external input matches (orb_common.verify_pins). evaluate.py and quote_check.py also require trades-selected.csv.gz to match its counts file, which must record the same protocol sha256 (orb_common.check_trades).
freeze_discipline.quote_page_disclosure: The raw cost-sample quote pages (quotes/pages, pinned through quotes/ledger.jsonl) hold bid and ask at trigger+15m, trigger+60m and close-5m, i.e. prices after the decision time. Only half-spreads were computed from them; no mid was compared with any trigger, stop or level, and no price change was derived.

live_shadow_hook: If any verdict is supported, a separate prospective protocol (new id, new freeze) runs the same orb_prepare/orb_signal code at 09:35 ET each session on live SIP data, records the would-be orders, trigger times and quotes without placing orders, and compares realised fills against F1 for a preregistered number of sessions before any paper order. Nothing in this study authorises paper or live orders.
pinned_artifacts_rule: simulate.py, quote_check.py and evaluate.py refuse when a private artifact or an external input differs from its pin (orb_common.verify_pins)
pre_freeze_computations: 1. orb_prepare.py or-table: 09:30-09:34 open/high/low/close/volume and regular-hours bar count per symbol-day for the 926 corpus symbols (1,957,885 rows).

2. orb_prepare.py candidates, first under the superseded per-year membership: split detection moved from the price factor (1,977 flagged windows, ex-dividend and spin-off sessions) to the share factor (D8); reruns byte-identical once the gzip timestamp was fixed. A distribution check of the split factor (pre-decision daily fields only) prompted D8.

3. orb_prepare.py select / triggers / verify-or / collect_quotes.py sample, fetch, table / evaluate.py power under the superseded membership (13,077 post-publication orders, 20,091 quote requests, all HTTP 200). Kept privately under v1-membership/ for the change count only.
4. orb_prepare.py membership (review fix 1): point-in-time top-500 membership, 2,403 sessions x 500; 3.2% of member symbol-days outside the corpus (membership.counts.json); byte-identical rerun.
5. orb_prepare.py candidates under it: 1,163,382 member symbol-days, 989,983 pass filters 1-3, 151 split-adjusted windows.
6. orb_prepare.py select: reproduction 34,913 selected (280 dojis), 4 of 1,746 sessions with fewer than 20 selectable names; post-publication 13,134 selected (55 dojis), 3 of 657.

7. orb_prepare.py triggers: first trigger minute from bar highs/lows at or after 09:35; reproduction 28,920 of 34,633 orders fired, post-publication 10,771 of 13,079. orb_prepare.py compare-membership: 1,596 post-publication orders only under the new pool, 1,594 only under the old.
8. orb_prepare.py verify-or: 233 sha-keyed symbol-days re-derived from raw bars with orb_signal.opening_range, 0 mismatches.
9. collect_quotes.py sample/fetch/table: 5,062 sampled fired orders, 20,175 stamps; 2,396 new GET requests (22,487 in the ledger), all HTTP 200; 7 stamps without a valid quote.
10. split_check.py fetch/compare: 19 GET requests to /v1/corporate-actions, all HTTP 200; 145 of 151 flagged windows confirmed (D8.cross_check).
11. evaluate.py power: MDE and minimum sample from trigger counts only.

No fill price, stop, exit, return, P&L, R, hit rate or post-decision price change was computed on real data, and no quote mid was compared with any trigger, stop or level. The only post-09:35 price data read were bar highs and lows for the trigger test and SIP quotes at the signal stamps (freeze_discipline.quote_page_disclosure).

quote_check.when: after the freeze and simulate.py run, before evaluate.py run (quote_check.py sample/fetch/apply, each behind the full guard)
quote_check.population: post-publication F1 trades with a stop exit (including same-bar stops) or a gap-through entry
quote_check.quote_time: newest valid SIP quote in the 60 s before the bar start for a gap-through fill (the fill is the bar open), before the bar end otherwise
quote_check.shift: per sampled trade dR = -sum over its checked executions of (measured - bucket half-spread) x base price / R per share; segment shift = (population / all trades of the leg) x mean dR; an execution without a valid quote contributes 0 and is counted
quote_check.use: a verdict additionally requires F1 mean net R + shift > 0 (combined for ORB-1 and ORB-3, long for ORB-2); until it has run, a would-be supported verdict reads 'pending'
